$comment: §26 submission checklist artefact. Every field is either a fact or an explicit null with a reason. Nothing here is aspirational.

product.name: Ambit
product.oneLiner: Ambit decides whether an agent may spend, before the money moves, using a deterministic policy engine and a Dynamic wallet the user still owns and can revoke at any moment.
product.tagline: The model can propose anything. It cannot widen the ambit.
product._urlsNote: Null because this build has not been published or recorded. §26 requires all submission links to be publicly viewable; a placeholder URL would be worse than an honest null.

track.prize: Best Agentic Wallet or Payment Experience
track._note: Selecting Dynamic in the Runtime submission form is R4 and is an owner action.

walletPattern.owner: the end user — their Dynamic embedded wallet, created at sign-in
walletPattern.agentAuthentication: user-approved delegated credentials (walletId, walletApiKey, keyShare) delivered to the Ambit webhook, RSA-decrypted and re-encrypted at rest
walletPattern.revocation: the user revokes unilaterally in the Dynamic SDK; Dynamic fires wallet.delegation.revoked and Ambit deletes the credentials

sdkVersions.x402: 1.2.0 (protocol reference; Ambit implements the client directly to sign through Dynamic)

dynamicCallSites.purpose: builds the delegated wallet client from the environment credentials
THE PAYMENT LEG — signs the EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization that becomes the transaction
delegation liveness probe; proves credentials work without needing a funded wallet
RSA-decrypts the credential envelope and stores it re-encrypted
deletes the credentials; every later spend request is 403 DELEGATION_REVOKED

dynamicCallSites.lines: the client-side surface, documented with the ./waas subpath requirement
dynamicCallSites.purpose: sign-in, delegation grant and revoke in the browser

rail.settlementMechanism: EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization signed as EIP-712 typed data and submitted by a facilitator
rail.standingAllowance: none — approve is never called on any ERC-20

_transactionHashesNote: EMPTY. No payment has been executed in this build: no Dynamic environment and no x402 facilitator were configured. This is R3 and gate G4, and it is the largest gap in the submission. The campaign records case C1x as NOT_ATTEMPTED rather than simulating it. See LIMITATIONS.md §10.

evidence.latestCampaign: 10 of 11 cases matched; C1x recorded NOT_ATTEMPTED

phase1Gate._note: G5 and G7 are met at integration level. The three not met all depend on provisioning a Dynamic environment with delegated access — §28 kill-criterion 1, an OWNER DECISION.

security.secretScanHook: scripts/scan-secrets.sh, installed via core.hooksPath, tested against a planted secret
security.knownOpenIssue: route-layer authentication is a header, not a signature. See SECURITY.md and DECISIONS.md D-009. Must be closed before public deployment.

token._note: Ambit does not launch a token. If that ever changes it must be launched, funded and distributed via Bankr.
